premise: Every surprise makes shy Hedgehog curl into a prickly ball — Mushroom's sneeze, Woodpecker's TAP TAP — so he keeps missing the fun; then his friends say hello softly, and out he peeks.
inspiration: The North Wind and the Sun (Aesop): what noise and bluster can't do, gentleness does; turned into two friends learning to whisper.
lesson: Gentleness makes room for shy friends.
learning: A hedgehog rolls into a prickly ball when something startles it.

en-US.title: Hedgehog Curls Up
en-US.text: [softly] {hedgehog:enter} Hedgehog wanted to play. But Hedgehog was shy. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:live talk} "Hello," he said, very quietly. Up popped {mushroom:enter} {hedgehog:go to mushroom} Mushroom. {mushroom:face happy} "Hello, Hedgehog!" Then her nose began to twitch. {mushroom:live sneeze} Ah… ah… {sfx:achoo} ACHOO! {hedgehog:face surprised} [gasps] "Oh!" {hedgehog:live curl hold} In a flash, Hedgehog rolled up into a round, prickly ball. Prickly ball! {mushroom:face sad} "Oops," said Mushroom. "Sorry." Slowly… slowly… {hedgehog:live curl resume} Hedgehog uncurled and peeked out. Then {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Woodpecker landed on the trunk of the big tree. [excited] "Good morning, everybody!" {woodpecker:live tap} {sfx:tap} TAP-TAP-TAP! {hedgehog:live curl hold} Prickly ball again! {woodpecker:face sad} "Oh dear," said Woodpecker. {mushroom:sparkle} Mushroom had an idea. [whispers] {woodpecker:go to hedgehog} "Let's say it softly." So, very gently, they whispered: {mushroom:face happy} {woodpecker:face happy} "Hello, Hedgehog." [pause] {hedgehog:live curl resume} Out came his nose. Out came his eyes. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:hearts} "Hello," he whispered back. And they played the quietest game in the whole meadow.

es-ES.title: Erizo se hace una bola
es-ES.text: [softly] {hedgehog:enter} Erizo tenía ganas de jugar. Pero Erizo era muy tímido. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:live talk} —Hola —dijo, bajito, bajito. Asomó {mushroom:enter} {hedgehog:go to mushroom} Seta. {mushroom:face happy} —¡Hola, Erizo! Y entonces empezó a picarle la nariz. {mushroom:live sneeze} Aaa… aaa… {sfx:achoo} ¡ACHÍS! {hedgehog:face surprised} [gasps] —¡Ay! {hedgehog:live curl hold} En un santiamén, Erizo se hizo una bola redonda de pinchos. ¡Bola de pinchos! {mushroom:face sad} —Uy —dijo Seta—. Perdona. Despacito… despacito… {hedgehog:live curl resume} Erizo se desenroscó y asomó el hocico. Entonces {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Pájaro carpintero se posó en el tronco del árbol grande. [excited] —¡Buenos días a todos! {woodpecker:live tap} {sfx:tap} ¡TOC-TOC-TOC! {hedgehog:live curl hold} ¡Bola de pinchos otra vez! {woodpecker:face sad} —Vaya —dijo Carpintero. {mushroom:sparkle} A Seta se le ocurrió una idea. [whispers] {woodpecker:go to hedgehog} —Vamos a decirlo flojito. Y los dos susurraron, muy suave: {mushroom:face happy} {woodpecker:face happy} —Hola, Erizo. [pause] {hedgehog:live curl resume} Asomó el hocico. Asomaron los ojitos. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:hearts} —Hola —susurró él. Y jugaron al juego más calladito de todo el prado.

achoo.prompt: a tiny, cute comic sneeze, achoo, with a soft sparkly twinkle after it, playful
